Option to allow boosting audio volume over 100%
# Checklist

- [x ] I have used the search function to see if someone else has already submitted the same feature request.
- [ x] I will only create one feature request per issue.
- [x ] I will describe the problem with as much detail as possible.

# System info

**App version**: 2.2.1 (latest)

**App source**: Google Play

# Feature description

**Problem you may be having, or feature you want**:
Some of the episodes I have are using a lower audio volume, and even if I'm at 100% of the volume I cannot hear correctly.

**Suggested solution**:
Maybe we could implement an option that allow to boost audio volume over 100% ?
For safety reasons, it could be an option that is disabled by default and is available to be enabled in the advanced settings tab.
